limitations: Four-direction 2D drawings derived from the approved design; small generative costume details can vary across source sheets.

candidateManifest.identityReferenceScope: Original male-direction.png is authoritative; fixed four-direction head master is a derived alignment reference. Short silver curls, narrow oval face and rounded chin; HUD directly samples original design.
